# HireKrkeDekho

> HireKrkeDekho is an AI-powered engineering career advisory, technical benchmarking, and daily coding contest platform designed for software engineers, developers, and tech professionals in India.

## Core Capabilities
- **Tri-Factor Matching Engine**: Calibrates career recommendations and real-time open roles across three dimensions: Degree, Years of Experience, and Core Technical Stack.
- **AI Career Advisor**: Conversational advisor that provides structured role analysis, salary bands (LPA), required skills, and tailored 3-week preparation guides for Indian tech hubs (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai).
- **Daily AI Race**: Daily 15-question rapid-fire technical benchmarking contest testing algorithms, data structures, and system design with server-timed anti-cheat and live leaderboards.

## Key URLs
- Home & Platform Overview: https://hirekrkedekho.vercel.app/
- AI Career Advisor: https://hirekrkedekho.vercel.app/consultation
- Daily Tech Contest: https://hirekrkedekho.vercel.app/#ai_race
- Privacy Policy: https://hirekrkedekho.vercel.app/privacy-policy
